alt: Sankey infographic: 80% of the plastic reaching the ocean comes from rivers. The Philippines contributes 29.1%, its Pasig river alone 12.1%.
summary: Sankey diagram of marine plastic pollution: 460 million tonnes a year, of which 80% (368 million) reaches the ocean through rivers and 20% comes from fishing. By country, the Philippines leads with 29.1%, followed by India (10.3%), Malaysia (6%) and China (5.8%). The most polluting rivers are the Pasig in the Philippines (12.1%), the Ulhas in India (3.5%), the Klang in Malaysia (3.3%), and the Chenzhen (3.1%) and Zhujiang (2.7%) in China. Source: Our World in Data. Infographic by Pablo Gomez, Data Monster, Earth Day 2023.
